registeredCohort.inclusion: First 100 chronologically ordered Alberta records with an official issue-time candidate and a strictly later official perimeter.
registeredCohort.exclusion: No strictly later attributable official perimeter, missing issue time, or missing incident identity.

selectionBias.reason: The registered cohort conditions on later-perimeter availability and is not a population sample.

easyCaseBias.reason: Cases without observable later truth are outside this adjudicable cohort and remain outside the denominator; results cannot be generalized to them.

claimBoundary: Audit pass establishes integrity and completeness only within the registered observable Alberta shadow cohort; it does not establish external calibration or agency impact.
